subject: Technical deep dive — finding overlap windows (US/EU/APAC)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Chris Barnes <chris@fintechx.com>, Elena Morozova <elena@globalbank.eu>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Scheduling: Technical deep dive (SE + customer architects)

Hi Chris and Elena —

Thanks again for the interest in a deeper technical session to walk through the integration points and performance expectations. Sean (solutions engineer) and Jonas (infra) will join from our side. We want this to be a focused 60–75 minute deep dive with architecture review, perf/latency Q&A, and a short run-through of the staging environment + sample traffic.

Because your team spans US/EU/APAC, I wanted to propose a couple of overlap windows in UTC (with local conversions) so we can find something that works across engineers:  
- Option A: 15 Jun 2026, 16:00–17:15 UTC (US: 09:00 PDT / 12:00 EDT; EU: 18:00 CEST; APAC: 00:00+1 SGT)  
- Option B: 16 Jun 2026, 08:00–09:15 UTC (US: 01:00 PDT / 04:00 EDT; EU: 10:00 CEST; APAC: 16:00 SGT)  
- Option C: 16 Jun 2026, 13:00–14:15 UTC (US: 06:00 PDT / 09:00 EDT; EU: 15:00 CEST; APAC: 21:00 SGT)

Notes: 
- We realize some of these hit late-night for APAC — if Sam (or another APAC architect) is only available earlier, happy to flip the structure (shorter core overlap with follow-up async notes).
- We’re also mindful of upcoming local DST differences (EU/US currently in DST; APAC not), so I included explicit UTC times to avoid confusion.

Attached: draft agenda (tech-deep-dive-agenda.pdf).

Please reply with which option(s) work or paste Sam’s availability and we’ll send a calendar invite + Zoom.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

-- attachment: tech-deep-dive-agenda.pdf (pdf, 1 page)

From: Chris Barnes <chris@fintechx.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Sam Tan <sam.tan@fintechx.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 20:42:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Scheduling: Technical deep dive (SE + customer architects)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear options. Quick note from our side: Sam (APAC) is based in Singapore (SGT, UTC+8) and prefers late afternoon local (15:00–18:00 SGT). Our EU architects (Elena) prefer 09:00–17:00 CEST but can be flexible by an hour.

Option C (16 Jun 13:00–14:15 UTC) looks best for us because that hits Sam at 21:00 SGT (a bit late but doable if we keep it tight), and works for our EU folks. Option A is early for APAC, and Option B is too early for US engineering.

If you can do a slightly earlier UTC time on 16 Jun (e.g., 12:30–13:45 UTC) that would make it 20:30 SGT — better for Sam — while still OK for EU/US. I’ve attached Sam’s availability screenshot.

Cheers,
Chris
Lead Architect, FintechX
chris@fintechx.com
